decisions.reason: Unlike the products removed by 2019, this cheese survived the initial test phase and by 2022 its market value is likely sufficiently proven to justify keeping it unless later sales data turn clearly negative.

This product also passed the early screening stage, but as a spicier variant it likely serves a narrower niche and therefore has a somewhat higher pruning risk if it adds complexity without enough volume.

A mild creamy soft cheese fits broad consumer demand and, having remained after the first year while weaker launches disappeared, it is the kind of option that management would usually continue rather than abandon.
